_note: Curated, citation-bearing content. Extracted measures live in .staging (produced by scripts/etl_analytics.py); this file is the editorial layer: what each dataset is, what controls must hold, and the audit facts that come from documents rather than from parquet. Every audit_posture row names its citation and whether it is a primary or secondary read.

datasets.label: Statement of Budgetary Resources (File A)
datasets.grain: Treasury Account Symbol x fiscal year
datasets.description: Budgetary resources, obligations incurred, unobligated balance and gross outlays at TAS grain, as submitted by reporting agencies. The backbone of the execution chain.
datasets.limitations: Carries five agency identifier codes; 011 (Executive Office of the President) is not the Department and is excluded from every DOW scope. The current fiscal year is a period-to-date submission, not a closed year.

datasets.label: Object Class and Program Activity (File B)
datasets.source_system: USASpending Account Breakdown by Program Activity and Object Class
datasets.grain: TAS x program activity x object class x fiscal year
datasets.description: Obligations decomposed into USSGL undelivered orders (480100 series) and delivered orders (490100 series), plus OMB object class. Shows what stage each obligated dollar has reached.
datasets.limitations: Object class is reported by the component; unreported and mixed classes appear as their own buckets rather than being redistributed.

datasets.label: Contract award transactions (FPDS)
datasets.grain: Contract action (transaction) x fiscal year x vintage
datasets.description: Federal action obligations for DoW contract actions. Two vintages are retained so that movement in closed fiscal years is measurable rather than assumed.
datasets.limitations: Federal action obligation is an FPDS reporting concept and is not the same measure as an account-linked obligation; see the reconciliation. The most recent fiscal year is incomplete.

datasets.label: Financial assistance transactions (cooperative agreements, grants, direct payments)
datasets.source_system: USASpending financial assistance archive, Department of War / Department of Defense awarding agency
datasets.grain: Assistance transaction x fiscal year x vintage
datasets.description: Federal action obligations for DoW financial-assistance awards — cooperative agreements, project and formula grants, and direct payments. A separate warehouse tree and reporting chain from contracts and File C; not account-linked and not reconciled against anything.
datasets.limitations: Rows are filtered to awarding-agency name ‘Department of Defense’ or ‘Department of War’ rather than an agency-identifier code, because this warehouse cut carries no code column. The assistance-type codes present are cooperative agreements, grants and direct payments — no loan or loan-guarantee type codes appear in this cut, so it is not a credit-programs picture and must not be described as one. Only two vintages are retained so far; vintage drift is measurable but thin.

datasets.label: Award-to-account linkage (File C)
datasets.grain: Award x TAS x fiscal year
datasets.description: Contract obligations that components have linked to a Treasury account. Compared against the award files to measure linkage completeness.
datasets.limitations: A low linkage percentage measures reporting completeness between two chains. It is not an estimate of unsupported or missing obligations, and must never be presented as one.

datasets.label: DoD-FM knowledge bank and curated wiki
datasets.source_system: Local knowledge bank; curated DoD-FM wiki pages
datasets.description: Definitions with authorities, document inventory by collection, FY2027 justification exhibits, and the congressional hearing record.
datasets.limitations: Hearing dates are the acquisition date embedded in the GPO filename, not the date the hearing was held; they are labelled as ingest dates and never as hearing dates.

datasets.label: Audit posture (documentary)
datasets.source_system: DoD FY2025 Agency Financial Report; DoD OIG
datasets.description: Audit opinion, material weakness counts and scope limitations, read from the Agency Financial Report rather than inferred from file counts.
datasets.limitations: Read via the curated wiki summary of the AFR, which is a secondary read of a primary document. Each row records which it is.

controls.name: Status of budgetary resources foots
controls.assertion: Obligations incurred plus unobligated balance equals total budgetary resources, within 0.1%.
controls.rationale: The status section of the SBR must equal the resources section. A break means the extract has dropped or double-counted a TAS.
controls.authority: OMB Circular A-136; DoD FMR Vol 6A

controls.name: Budgetary resources components foot
controls.assertion: Appropriated authority, unobligated balance brought forward, adjustments, and other budgetary resources sum to total budgetary resources, within 0.5%.
controls.rationale: Proves the resources waterfall shown on the execution page is complete. Note that the source's other-budgetary-resources column already rolls up borrowing authority, contract authority and spending authority from offsetting collections; adding those separately double-counts them.

controls.name: Outlays do not exceed resources
controls.assertion: Gross outlays are less than or equal to total budgetary resources.
controls.rationale: An outlay above available resources indicates a scope or sign error, not an Antideficiency event in this dataset.

controls.name: File A and File B obligations agree
controls.assertion: Obligations incurred per File B are within 0.5% of File A for the same scope, fiscal year and submission period.
controls.rationale: File A and File B are separate submissions of the same execution at different grain. A variance is a cross-system reconciliation finding to be published and explained, not a reason to withhold the data - so this control reports rather than blocks.

controls.name: Department scope excludes non-Department agencies
controls.assertion: No DOW-scope figure includes agency identifier code 011.
controls.rationale: File A carries five agency codes. Including the Executive Office of the President in a Department total overstates it materially.
controls.authority: Treasury Account Symbol structure; OMB agency codes

controls.name: Linkage cannot exceed the population
controls.assertion: File C account-linked contract obligations do not exceed award-file obligations for the same fiscal year.
controls.rationale: Linkage above 100% would mean the subset is larger than the set, indicating a scope mismatch between the two chains.

controls.name: Every load carries a vintage
controls.assertion: Every current dm_load row has a non-null vintage and extraction timestamp.
controls.rationale: A figure without a vintage cannot be defended, reproduced, or compared against a later extract.

controls.name: Incomplete fiscal years are flagged
controls.assertion: Any fiscal year whose submission period is not P12 is marked as partial.
controls.rationale: An in-progress year shown beside closed years reads as collapsed execution unless it is labelled.

controls.name: Every definition carries an authority
controls.assertion: Every published definition names at least one authoritative source.
controls.rationale: A definitions registry without citations is an opinion, not a standard.

controls.name: Dimensional cuts do not exceed the fiscal-year total
controls.assertion: For each dimension, the sum of the retained top-N buckets does not exceed that fiscal year's award total.
controls.rationale: Guards the double-counting failure mode where a record increments more than one bucket.

controls.name: Assistance dimensional cuts do not exceed the fiscal-year total
controls.assertion: For each dimension, the sum of the retained top-N buckets does not exceed that fiscal year's assistance total.
controls.rationale: Same double-counting guard as AWD-01 (contract awards), applied to the assistance dimension cuts.
